setting.help: The default value for the Saxon Server URL is http://localhost:5000/transform If you need to use another URL, you can enter it below.

For Factur-X, the official schematron file depends on an external CodeDB XML file, but Saxon Server is not designed to receive this external CodeDB XML file in the HTTP schematron validation request. By default, Odoo replaces the external CodeDB XML files by a public URL, but it adds extra latency in the schematron validation to retrieve the CodeDB file. To avoid that, you can put the CodeDB XML files in a dedicated directory on the Saxon Server and specifiy the directory in the parameter below.
